meta.title: gogh — The broken first page (explore/fix-page branch)
meta.description: A brand-new person's first page arrives a little broken: drag the headline straight, say what you do, fix the clashing button, put a picture in. Built from the explore/fix-page branch, not a release.
meta.author: jamiemarsland

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option( 'gogh_booted_as', 'fix-page' );
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
try { wp_trash_post( 1 ); } catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
// a brand-new person on a brand-new, empty page: the broken first page's stage
$id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => 'Home', 'post_content' => '' ) );
if ( $id && ! is_wp_error( $id ) ) {
	update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
	update_option( 'page_on_front', (int) $id );
}
delete_user_meta( 1, '_gogh_first_minute' );
